knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The item stays out of use until a specialist decision exists. Appearance and a quick wipe do not decide it.
The basis and the decision-maker must be recorded.

practicalCriteria: For a fictional set of items, the learner assigns keep, quarantine or refer and writes the basis for each. Pass: every item has a status and a basis.
The learner writes a refusal note for a request to return a stained item to use. Pass: the note states the reason and the referral.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: A request is made to return an unresolved item to use.
